item.title: Hiroshima Winter Illuminations: Lights on Peace Boulevard — Guide
item.description: Through the winter months, Hiroshima strings its broad Peace Boulevard and the adjacent Heiwa-odori park with elaborate illuminations, in an annual display long known to locals as Dreamination. Themed light sculptures, arches and tunnels of glowing bulbs line the avenue for several hundred metres, turning an ordinary walk into a cheerful evening outing that draws couples, families and photographers from across the city. It is free to walk, runs nightly for several weeks over the coldest part of the year, and offers a warm, bright counterpoint to a city that otherwise feels quiet in winter.
